units: hbar = c = m = 1, e absorbed: E in units of E_S = m^2/e; lattice spacing a = theta / m
inputs: m (through theta = m a), field shapes and amplitudes (the experiment being simulated)
rule: lab/assist_core.py walk_pairs: zig-zag 1+1 D (R1 method), mode by mode, Peierls phase at mid-tick
reference: lab/assist_core.py dirac_pairs: continuum 1+1 Dirac, 4th-order Magnus, dt = 0.01 (0.005 check)
richardson: f_extrap = (4 f(theta=0.025) - f(theta=0.05)) / 3  (assumes O(theta^2), checked by the 0.1/0.05 ratio)

exams.V1a: max_p |f_lat(theta=0.0125)/f_exact - 1| <= 0.03 over modes with f_exact > 1e-3 f_exact(0), and Richardson(0.025, 0.0125) <= 0.01
exams.V1b: |N_lat(theta=0.0125) / N_LCFA - 1| <= 0.10, N_LCFA = int dt E(t)/(2 pi) exp(-pi/E(t)) (local Schwinger-Nikishov rate)

exams.V2: for every gamma: |f_lat(0)/f_exact(0) - 1| <= 0.03 and |N_lat/N_exact - 1| <= 0.03 at theta = 0.025; Richardson(0.05, 0.025) within 0.01

V3_multiphoton.field: A(t) = xi m sin(omega t), p = 0; resonances n = 1..5 located as minima of the Floquet splitting

exams.V3a: selection rule at p = 0: Delta_n(even) / Delta_{n+1}(odd) <= 1e-2 for n = 2, 4 (both xi), walk
exams.V3b: multiphoton law Delta_n ~ xi^n: log2(Delta_n(0.2)/Delta_n(0.1)) within 5% of n, n = 1, 3, 5, walk

V3_multiphoton.report: omega_n vs the adiabatic dressed-energy estimate n omega = 2 qbar (not graded)

A_sauter.field: E(t) = E1 sech^2(gs E1 t) + eps E1 sech^2(gamma E1 t)  (gamma = m omega/E1 combined Keldysh)

observables.f0: pair number in the mode p = 0 (crosses the gap at the pulse peak)
observables.Q: eps -> 0 response Q = [f(+eps) + f(-eps) - 2 f(0)] / (2 eps^2), eps = 0.01 (0.005 check)
observables.S_fit: fit ln Q = -S/E1 + nu ln(1/E1) + c over E1_fit (3 parameters, 5 points)
observables.N: int dp/2pi f(p), p in [-4, 4], dp = 0.01, at E1 = 0.1; with E1 only, eps pulse only, both

predictions.note: S_wi = eps->0 worldline instanton (Schuetzhold-Gies-Dunne 2008) with the slow field sech^2(Om t) kept: instanton cut at tau = pi/(2 omega); gs -> 0 gives eq. 15

exams.A1: rule vs continuum: |f_lat(theta=0.025)/f_Dirac - 1| <= 0.03 and Richardson <= 0.01 for f(0) at every (gamma, E1, eps in {0, +-0.01, 0.1}); and |Q_lat/Q_Dirac - 1| <= 0.05 (Q from Richardson values)
exams.A2: exponent: |S_fit(rule)/S_wi(gamma, gs) - 1| <= 0.03 for gamma <= 6 (gamma = 10, omega = m: reported)
exams.A3: threshold: one-parameter fit S(gamma) = S_wi(gamma * gc_pred/gc, gs) to S_fit(rule), gamma <= 6 -> |gc/gc_pred - 1| <= 0.05 (gc_pred = 1.5915; = pi/2 for gs -> 0)
exams.A4: report only (prediction of the model): f(0), N, enhancement N_both/(N_E1 + N_eps) at E1 = 0.1, eps = 0.01, 0.1, all gamma and gamma = 20 (omega = 2m); compared with WKB (finite eps) and with zeroth+first order in eps (Torgrimsson et al. 2017: should suffice for Sauter)

O_cos.field: A(t) = (E1/Om) tanh(Om t) + (eps E1/omega) sin(omega t) sech^2(Om t), Om = gs E1

observables.S_fit: fit ln f(0) = -S/E1 + nu ln(1/E1) + c over E1_fit; S0_fit same with eps = 0

exams.O1: rule vs continuum: |f_lat(0.025)/f_Dirac - 1| <= 0.03, Richardson <= 0.01, all configs
exams.O2: where the first-order correction 2 eps I1(gamma)/gamma <= 0.3: |S_fit/S_WKB - 1| <= 0.03 (S_WKB = exact-field WKB exponent at p = 0, dominant turning point)
exams.O3: where 2 eps I1(gamma)/gamma <= 0.05 (first order trustworthy): |(S_fit/S0_fit) / s_Linder - 1| <= 0.03 (Linder et al. 2015 eq. 37)
exams.O4: report only: points beyond (gamma ~ |ln eps|, nonperturbative / omega ~ m)

limits_report: 1+1 vs 3+1: via m -> m_perp identity (spin factor 2, integral over p_perp) for one config; real lasers: table of E/E_S, omega/m, gamma and exponent for ELI-class + XFEL (not graded)
